data.name: MWM_001
data.value: This wind is relentless...[pause=15] We must be really high up now.

data.name: MWM_002
data.value: Hey...[pause=10] did you feel that? The ground shook.

data.name: MWM_003
data.value: A rockslide!

data.name: MWM_004
data.value: A Gligar burst out of the wall!

data.name: MWM_005
data.value: A Skarmory dive-bombing![pause=10] There's two of them!

data.name: MWM_006
data.value: The Sentinels of the Peak...

data.name: MWM_007
data.value: You again![pause=10] Who are you?!

data.name: MWM_008
data.value: One commands the earth, the other the skies.[pause=20] Together, they are nearly invincible.

data.name: MWM_009
data.value: But every sentinel has its weakness...[pause=20] Find it.

data.name: MWM_010
data.value: We'll show them what we're made of![pause=10] Attack!

data.name: MWM_011
data.value: We're not giving up.[pause=15] This time, we break through!

data.name: MWM_012
data.value: We got the upper hand![pause=10] Those two won't stop us anymore.

data.name: MWM_013
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] You think it gave us a hint?

data.name: MWM_014
data.value: Maybe.[pause=20] Or maybe it just wants to see us succeed.

data.name: MWM_015
data.value: The sentinels pushed you back...

data.name: MWM_016
data.value: Learn from this defeat.[pause=30] The summit awaits only the strongest.

data.name: MWM_017
data.value: It's...[pause=10] it's too much for us![pause=15] We have to go back down!

data.name: MWM_018
data.value: Gligar snaps its claws, triumphant.[pause=10] Skarmory hovers above you,[pause=5] menacing.

data.name: MWM_019
data.value: The peaks are not for the weak.[pause=20] Go back down. Come back stronger.

data.name: MWM_020
data.value: They rise back into the updrafts,[pause=15] their silhouettes melting into the clouds.

data.name: MWM_021
data.value: Skarmory crashes to the ground with a metallic clang.[pause=10] Gligar retreats,[pause=5] wings folded.

data.name: MWM_022
data.value: Gligar te jette un dernier regard avant de s'envoler.[pause=20] Un regard qui en dit long.

data.name: MWM_023
data.value: You...[pause=15] you've earned the right to climb higher.[pause=20] Don't disappoint us.

data.name: MWM_024
data.value: They disappear into the wind,[pause=10] leaving the path to the summit clear.

data.name: MWM_025
data.value: We got them![pause=10] Not even the wind could stop us!

data.name: MWM_026
data.value: The sentinels recognize strength.[pause=20] You earn their respect.

data.name: MWM_027
data.value: The sky has its guardians. Prove you deserve the summit.

data.name: MWM_028
data.value: The summit is close. What we've felt since we set out... it's up there.
